metrics.bit_rate: 32 divided by the ratio of original bytes to actual compressed-stream bytes
metrics.psnr: independently recomputed from float32 source and reconstruction with double-precision squared-error accumulation
metrics.asz_predictor_family: automatically selected per dataset and error bound from cubic versus quintic MSE on the generated plan's final-layer direction

comparison.baseline: pointwise lower bit rate of SZ3 and QoZ at equal PSNR
comparison.interpolation: Pareto-filtered piecewise linear interpolation in log(bit rate) versus PSNR over the common PSNR interval
comparison.aggregation: geometric mean over PSNR within each dataset, followed by the equal-weight geometric mean of the six dataset rate ratios
